organizer-11673.title: Hungarian Hardstyle
organizer-11673.content:
Hungarian Hardstyle is Hungary's leading hardstyle and hardcore community platform, presenting the most important news, interviews, music releases and events of the domestic and international hard dance scene. Our mission is to connect fans, support Hungarian artists, and contribute to the development of hardstyle culture in Hungary.

Alongside the news site, we organise our own events, run the Hardstyle Revolution event series and record label, and actively build the domestic hard dance community both online and offline. Over the past years we have brought international artists to Hungary including D-Sturb, TNT, Aftershock, Hard Driver, Noisecontrollers and Sound Rush.
